title: Power station
label: Generating unit: cutaway turbo-generator with glowing core, flywheel guard, step-up transformer and a three-phase switchyard under a lattice gantry. Moving across the figure steps the switching sequence.
caption: A 660 MW generator turning at 3,000 rpm feeds a transformer lifting 22 to 400 kV. Open the breaker first and the stator glow drops as the current stops; then lift the disconnector blades. Lift the blades while the breaker still carries load and an arc climbs between blade and jaw. Move across the figure or use the arrow keys to step the sequence.
